value.construction: append cumulative ionic suffixes to the parent hydride name
value.elision: elide terminal e before i, y, or a cumulative suffix beginning with a vowel
value.multiplication: use di/tri or bis/tris as appropriate for each suffix type

value.value: This treatment changes RC-84.1.1 (reference 3) and is illustrated by the final example in P-74.1.1.
For the alternative representation as an intramolecular adduct, apply P-68.1.6.2.

value.construction: add the appropriate ionic suffix to the ionic parent hydride name

value: attachment positions of suffix-expressed characteristic groups

value.value: prefix the cationic-center name or cation-containing structural parts to the anionic parent-structure name
Do not use names such as diborazane as parent hydrides; apply P-21.2.3.1.

value.major_canonical_form: carries a positive and a negative charge

subclasses.1,3-dipolar: a significant canonical form separates charge over three atoms

allowed_methods: lambda convention for P, As, Sb, Bi, S, Se, or Te

representations.third_or_later_row_X: uncharged canonical form RmX=YRn usually shown

value.structure: RmX+-Y-Rn with an anionic Y directly attached to formally positive heteroatom X

methods: zwitterion based on hydrazine without breaking the nitrogen chain
functional class name with imide after the amine name

value.criterion: a significant canonical resonance form distributes charge over three atoms

methods: cationic substituent in a parent anion

value.value: For azoxy compounds under P-74.2.2.1.4, use the heteroatom-oxide method rather than the default zwitterionic preference.
For nitrones under P-74.2.2.1.9, use the heteroatom-oxide method rather than the default zwitterionic preference.
For heterone S-oxides under P-74.2.2.1.8, use the lambda-convention method rather than the default zwitterionic preference.
